# Byte Hero

> Byte Hero is a small game studio that makes mobile and browser games, plus books, for curious minds. Its first game is GeoQuiz, a free geography quiz played on a spinning 3D globe. The website is available in Polish (default, https://byte-hero.com/) and English (https://byte-hero.com/en).

Key facts:

- Studio: Byte Hero, website https://byte-hero.com
- First game: GeoQuiz (also written "Geo Quiz"), a geography quiz and educational game
- GeoQuiz content: flags, capitals, country shapes and locations of nearly 200 countries on six continents
- GeoQuiz modes: Flags, Countries, Shapes, Capitals, Where is it, Learn; quiz rounds of 5, 10 or 15 questions
- GeoQuiz languages: Polish, English, German
- GeoQuiz price: free, with no ads, no in-app purchases and no account
- GeoQuiz platforms: web browser at https://geoquiz.byte-hero.com/ (no installation); Android app coming soon to Google Play (package com.bytehero.geoquiz)
- GeoQuiz privacy: collects no personal data; only the chosen language and globe style are stored on the device
- Planned: more games (arcade games and shooters) and books (an e-book and a printed edition)
